inputs.prompt: ONE original stocky biped robot, the Foreclosure Engine veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the dark iron and worn brass riveted body, the closed cylindrical brass head with an orange eye, the furnace-barrel chest with glowing orange bars, the one short chimney behind the near shoulder, the cog emblem on the near pauldron, the two chain-hung brass debt tags, the engraved metal apron and the heavy rectangular boots. Exactly two arms and two legs. The near screen-LEFT arm ends in ONE giant two-jaw crescent clamp; the far screen-RIGHT arm ends in ONE mechanical fist. Preserve the clamp, the fist, the furnace chest and the heavy proportions. Collapse slowly and heavily. The eye and chest glow dim, the knees buckle and the robot sinks down onto its clamp and knees, stays there a moment, then topples forward and lies flat on its front, finishing motionless with the head at screen right, the clamp lying open on the ground and the tags spilled beside it. The same body throughout: no explosion, no steam and no disappearing. Locked orthographic camera, fixed scale and centred body. Keep the full clamp, the fist, the chimney and both boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, smoke, steam, sparks, flames, motion trails, particles or extra limbs; the chest bars and eye keep only their steady glow. The robot moves at its joints; the armour stays rigid and never morphs.
